mapper.insert: insert ignore into official_broadcast_log (broadcast_id, member_id, role, channel, reached, clicked, create_time) values (#{broadcastId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, #{channel}, #{reached}0, 0, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and reached = 1
select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and clicked = 1
select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where member_id = #{memberId} and channel = 'inapp' and reached = 1 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
mapper.update: update official_broadcast_log set clicked = 1 where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and member_id = #{memberId} and channel = #{channel}
update official_broadcast_log set reached = 1 where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and member_id = #{memberId} and channel = #{channel}
